Notes: PvP daily giver behind Antiques n' such, Borealis. KTCM / PVBS / PVTA live. Reclaiming the Land still deferred.

jobs.Text: What kind of work do you have?

bs.Text: Battlestation. Tip the scales for UBSL.

land.Text: Reclaiming the land — land control towers.

hello.Text: John Smith. Keep your voice down. I move Victory Point work for people who would rather not sit a full Battle Station, and a few dirtier jobs besides.

jobs.Text: Four cards: Battlestation tip (up to three per eighteen hours), Tarasque, illegal notum miners, or reclaiming land-control towers. Pick one.

bs.Text: Queue the Battle Station. When either side hits four-twenty-five while you are in the match, the daily pays. You can clear it up to three times per eighteen hours.{givedaily PVBS}

tara.Text: Tarasque stalks Avalon by Camelot Castle. Put it down and the daily pays.{givedaily PVTA}

miners.Text: Kill three Rogue Notum Miners dealing in illegal notum. Field is Stret West Notum Ore for now until the real Notum Mining Area is up. A Ganking Uncle Pumpkin-Head can show every run.{givedaily KTCM}

land.Text: Reclaiming the Land still needs land-control tower targeting we do not have. Try Battlestation, Tarasque, or the notum miners.

done.Text: Good work. Here is your pay.{completequest KTCM}
